input: Compare the combustion mechanisms of BASS-II and FLEX. Can their burning rate measurements be directly plotted on the same physical scale?
context: BASS-II studies solid PMMA surface flame spread (mm/s). FLEX studies liquid droplet spherical evaporation and d-square law diameter regression (mm/s or mm2/s).
target: No, their measurements cannot be combined on the same physical scale. BASS-II investigates solid-phase fuel pyrolyzing into surface flame spread (linear velocity in mm/s influenced by solid thickness and fuel thermal response). In contrast, FLEX investigates isolated liquid droplet combustion governed by the classical d²-law and radiative cool-flame extinction. Comparing them requires maintaining physical track separation as done in scientific combustion engineering.
